manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball passing through zero velocity at its peak with a ball dropped from rest at that exact moment.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top of the toss, its velocity is zero while gravity continuously accelerates it downward, identical to the ball released from rest.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
